title: CLARKSONS HELLAS - SnP WEEKLY
summary:
Main
Dry Cargo
As mentioned, the Kamsarmax sector has seen particularly strong activity recently, with a number of around 10 years old vessels changing hands. The MEDI POSITANO (ABT 82K DWT, 2015, TSUNEISHI ZOSEN, SCRUBBER) was sold to Greek Buyers for around USD 32m. Meanwhile, the PRESINGE (ABT 82K DWT, 2015 TSUNEISHI ZHOUSHAN) has been acquired by Indian interests for USD 29.25m.
